summary.en-US: Blocks ads on Twitch live streams.

description.en-US:
Blocks ads on Twitch live streams in Firefox.

Privacy: Nothing is sent to the developer or anyone else. To get an ad-free stream, the extension uses your Twitch login only with Twitch itself.

Turn off other Twitch ad blockers before using it.

Source code: https://github.com/bragon9/twitch-block-delta

version.approval_notes: No build step: the submitted files are the source, unminified (github.com/bragon9/twitch-block-delta). The auth-token cookie from twitch.tv is read in src/probe.js (getTwitchOAuth) and sent only as the Authorization header to gql.twitch.tv to request a playback token. That token is used to fetch Twitch's own playlists (usher.ttvnw.net). No data leaves the browser except these requests to Twitch. For that reason, data_collection_permissions is "none". webRequestBlocking and filterResponseData rewrite Twitch media playlists in flight. "downloads" is only used when the user turns logging on, to save debug logs locally.
